name: GTA GU1 & GU2 Data Centers and Cable Landing Stations (Piti)
notes: GTA official page (checked 2026-08-12): GU1/GU2 are Tier 3-designed data centers and cable landing stations, carrier-neutral colocation with 2 MW across 11,800 sq ft, landing points for JGA North, JGA South and SEA-US, located in Piti. Per GU methodology, kept separate from GNC iX unless a source proves same physical site (Baxtel C-grade caption suggests GU1&GU2 = GNC iX aerial view).

name: GTA GU3 / Alupang Data Center and Cable Landing Station (Tamuning)
notes: GTA official page: GU3 designed to Tier 3 specification, 32,000+ sq ft, 4 MW, serves as data center and cable landing station, 'ready for equipment in Q3 2025' - no official commissioning evidence found as of 2026-08-12, so kept construction. DCD/PostGuam (B): Alupang Data Center groundbreaking Oct 2022 in Tamuning, ~31,000 sq ft, 4 MW, completion expected late 2024; Baxtel (C) lists the site as 'GTA: Alupang GU3', identifying Alupang as GU3.

name: GNC iX Data Center / Cable Landing Station (Piti)
developer: Gateway Network Connections LLC (RTI + GTA joint venture)
notes: Guam's first combined neutral cable landing station and data center, owned by Gateway Network Connections LLC, in Piti adjacent to GTA Piti-I CLS. Trade/industry sources (Submarine Networks, B): ~11,800 sq ft, ~250 racks, 2 MW, Type 3 designed. GTA newsroom (A-, 2023) confirms GTA operates Guam's first locally owned CLS+DC in Piti and PLDT selected GNC iX as a strategic PoP; datacenters.com/datacentermap (C) list GNC iX as operational. Capacity/specs B/C; directory (Baxtel C) suggests GNC iX = GU1&GU2, kept separate per methodology.

name: Guam Exchange / Citadel Pacific Data Center (Harmon, Tamuning)
notes: Official page (checked 2026-08-12): carrier-neutral colocation with 2 data halls spanning ~8,000 sq ft whitespace, Diesel Generator N+1, UPS 3N2, CRAC N+1, 7x24x365 security and NOC; address 122 West Harmon Industrial Park Rd Ste 103, Tamuning 96913. Pacific Island Times (B) reported Citadel launched Guam Exchange with Harmon 1 as open-access, Tier III compliant data center.

name: DOCOMO Pacific Data Center - Agana (Hagatna)
notes: Official colocation page names three secure off-site colocation facilities: Agana, Harmon and Piti, with 99.99% uptime SLA, power, cooling, security and connectivity. This record covers the Agana (Hagatna) facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: DOCOMO Pacific Data Center - Harmon (Dededo/Harmon)
notes: Official colocation page lists Harmon as one of three facilities. Directories (DataCenterMap, C) list DoCoMo Harmon Data Center at 467 Harmon Loop Road, Dededo with ~1 MW - directory capacity/address unverified (directories often mislabel Guam villages, per methodology).

name: DOCOMO Pacific Data Center - Piti

name: Guam Government Tier IV Data Center / World-class IXP (site TBD)
developer: Government of Guam (Office of the Governor)
notes: Guam Five-Year Action Plan (announced by Office of the Governor, Aug 2023) proposes a 'green, Tier IV data center that will serve as a world-class IXP'; site not yet selected; criteria include high elevation near ocean, multiple power grid access points, land for a 5-10 MW solar farm and tech park, >$60M potential investment (DCD B; official plan PDF A). No update found by 2026-08-12; status announced.

name: University of Guam Government Data Center / Office of Information Technology building (Mangilao)
developer: Government of Guam / University of Guam
notes: Guam Five-Year Action Plan: planned 15,000 sq ft, two-story data center/Office of Information Technology building at the University of Guam campus (Mangilao), ~$15M investment (DCD reporting of the official plan). Status announced/planned; no construction evidence found by 2026-08-12.

name: UOG Computer Center (University of Guam, Mangilao)
notes: Existing main campus data center (built 1992), described by DCD as the University's main data center; hosts Hurricane Electric PoP (2020) and content-provider services. Government/university facility; included per DCD reporting (B), capacity unknown.

name: Andersen Air Force Base Data Center (36th Wing, Yigo)
notes: Defense/telecom facility per GU methodology (listed separately from commercial colo): DVIDS 36th Wing story references a data center at Andersen AFB, Guam (Oct). No public capacity/specs; no coordinates guessed.

name: NAVFAC Guam Communications Center Upgrades / Andersen AFB data center project (36th Communications Squadron)
notes: NAVFAC Pacific awarded a $289,762,614 firm-fixed-price contract (announced Sept 2025, official NAVFAC Pacific channel, A) for communications center upgrades in Guam. DCD reporting (B, per GU methodology baseline) described the tender as a two-story reinforced concrete communications center for the 36th Communications Squadron with generator building ('data center' characterization is media, B). May correspond to upgrading the existing Andersen AFB data center; keep approved until solicitation/construction confirms explicit data-center scope.
